cases.query: My Galaxy S23 keeps disconnecting from my Bluetooth earbuds every few minutes.

siis_response.title: Bluetooth connection keeps dropping on a Galaxy phone
siis_response.content:
# Bluetooth devices disconnect frequently
Bluetooth connections can drop because of interference or an outdated pairing record.
## Re-pair the device
1. Open Settings.
2. Tap Connections, then tap Bluetooth.
3. Tap the gear icon next to your earbuds and tap Unpair.
4. Put the earbuds in pairing mode and tap them in the list of available devices.
## Reduce interference
- Keep the phone and earbuds within 10 metres of each other.
- Move away from microwaves and Wi-Fi routers while you test the connection.
## Update your software
Navigate to Settings, tap Software update, and then tap Download and install.

cases.query: battery on my galaxy a54 drains really fast even when im not using it

siis_response.title: Battery drains quickly on Galaxy phone
siis_response.content: If your battery drains faster than expected, some apps may be running in the background. Go to Settings and tap Battery to see which apps use the most power. Tap Background usage limits and turn on Put unused apps to sleep. You can also turn on Power saving from the Quick settings panel. Lowering the screen brightness also helps extend battery life.

cases.query: Wi-Fi keeps saying connected without internet on my Galaxy Tab S9

siis_response.title: Connected to Wi-Fi but no internet
siis_response.content:
Step 1: Restart your router
Unplug the router, wait 30 seconds, and plug it back in.
Step 2: Forget the network
Go to Settings > Connections > Wi-Fi.
Tap the gear icon next to the network, then tap Forget.
Select the network again and enter the password.
Step 3: Reset network settings
Navigate to Settings, tap General management, tap Reset, and then tap Reset network settings.
Note: This removes saved Wi-Fi networks and paired Bluetooth devices.

cases.query: The notifications from WhatsApp don't show up on my Galaxy S21 until I open the app

siis_response.title: Notifications are delayed or missing
siis_response.content:
Smartphone Notifications are delayed or missing ( Smartphone): ## Check app notification settings
Open Settings and tap Notifications. Tap App notifications and make sure the switch next to the app is turned on.
## Allow background activity
Go to Settings, tap Apps, select the app, tap Battery, and then select Unrestricted.
## Turn off Do not disturb
Swipe down to open the Quick settings panel and tap Do not disturb to turn it off.

cases.query: my phone got really hot while charging and the back looks swollen

siis_response.title: Device overheating or swollen battery
siis_response.content:
# Overheating and battery swelling
A swollen battery is a safety risk.
- Stop using the device immediately and unplug the charger.
- Do not press on the back of the device or try to remove the battery yourself.
- Keep the device away from heat sources and flammable materials.
- Contact an authorized service center to have the battery replaced.

cases.query: How can I make the text bigger on my Galaxy A35? My mom can't read it.

siis_response.title: Change the font size on your Galaxy phone
siis_response.content:
You can change the font size and style to make text easier to read.
To change the font size:
Navigate to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Font size and style.
Drag the slider under Font size to adjust the size.
To make everything larger:
Navigate to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Screen zoom.
Drag the slider to the right.

cases.query: What is Bixby Routines and how do I use it?

siis_response.title: What are Bixby Routines?
siis_response.content:
## What are Bixby Routines?
Bixby Routines let your phone change settings automatically based on time, place or activity. They can save battery and time.
## Why use them?
Routines reduce repetitive tasks.

siis_response.title: Galaxy phone restarts by itself
siis_response.content:
1) Check for software updates in Settings > Software update.
2) Boot into Safe mode to see if a downloaded app is the cause.
3) If the problem continues, back up your data and contact a Samsung service centre.

siis_response.title: Camera keeps stopping
siis_response.content:
Clear the camera cache.

  • Open Settings
  • Tap Apps
  • Select Camera, tap Storage, then tap Clear cache.

For more help visit Samsung Support.

cases.query: HOW DO I TURN ON DARK MODE

siis_response.title: DARK MODE
siis_response.content:
DARK MODE
• Swipe down from the top of the screen to open the Quick panel.
• Tap Dark mode to switch it on.
• Or go to Settings, tap Display, and then tap Dark.

siis_response.title: SIM card not detected
siis_response.content: Remove the SIM tray with the ejection tool and reinsert the SIM card. Restart the phone. If the SIM is still not detected, try another SIM card to check whether the tray or card is faulty.

siis_response.title: Liquid damage
siis_response.content: Turn off the device immediately. Do not charge it. Do not use a hair dryer or put it in rice. Wipe it with a soft cloth and take it to a Samsung service centre.

siis_response.title: Bluetooth pairing with a car
siis_response.content:
# Pair with your car
To pair:
Open Settings.
Tap Connections, and then tap Bluetooth.
Tap the switch to turn on Bluetooth.
Select your car from the list of available devices.
To unpair:
Tap the gear icon next to the car and tap Unpair.

siis_response.title: Change the screen timeout
siis_response.content: Go to Settings > Display > Screen timeout and choose a longer time.
